products.name: Configurable packing station and workbench
products.summary: Packing station and workbench with an aluminium profile frame, made to your size. Choose dimensions, shelves and accessories and see it in 3D.
products.description:
Made to your size
This work table is made to order. Instead of choosing from fixed sizes, you set the worktop width, depth and height, decide how many shelves you need and add the accessories your work requires. The 3D view shows the result as you change it.

Checked at every change
The frame is recalculated automatically each time you change something. A combination that cannot be built is not accepted, so every valid configuration is a table that can really be made.

Aluminium profile frame
The frame is a modular system of aluminium profiles with a 30 × 30 mm cross-section and an 8 mm slot, joined with corner connectors. The slots along the profiles make it possible to adjust shelves and accessories.

For packing and workshop use
The table suits packing and dispatch areas, workplaces for assembly work and workshops. Because you choose the worktop height, the table can be set to suit the people who use it. Accessories for lighting, power, storage and mobility are added in the configurator.

Delivery, assembly and shipping
The table is made to order and delivery takes 3–5 weeks. Assembly is an optional service: with it the table is delivered assembled, without it disassembled, and you assemble it yourself. The shipping price depends on whether you choose assembly; we set it after the order and confirm it with you before the proforma invoice is issued.
